cytokine_1.resolution: The expansion adds reviewed human-response evidence for CSF2, IL16, IL17A, IL5, IL13, IL1A, IL2, IL6 and multiple chemokines; explicit LTA complexes, VEGFA165 and IL12p70 are separately identified. Original assay identities and comprehensive source-to-target coverage remain unresolved.

cytokine_2.resolution: Full primary Methods and Results for C-S05 and C-S07 were inspected; all four inherited affected assertions were corrected and independently rechecked. The unrelated C-S04 OCR precision limitation remains.

cytokine_8.resolution: Receptor expansion now includes cell-free LTA-complex binding, whole-monocyte VEGFA165 binding and targeted proximal phosphorylation measurements. Comprehensive dose/time grids, ancestry stratification and citation chaining remain open.

proteomic_2.resolution: Primary atlas Methods/Results and CITE-seq Methods plus exact supplementary captions have been recovered and independently reviewed. Atlas IL34 phenotype is retained with an unresolved CD4 cell-gate discrepancy and inconclusive conventional-memory scoring. Raw proteome/ADT matrices and peptide-level reanalysis remain open.

cytokine_expansion_2.resolution: All 22 assertions have full-article Methods/Results coverage and passed independent review at the exact approved extraction/source hashes. Selected supporting passages are archived; scientific limitations in the other gap rows remain.
